idea-plugin.name: Config Doctor
idea-plugin.description:
Config Doctor detects suspicious Spring Boot YAML configuration structures (for example, an accidentally duplicated nesting level, such as spring.datasource.datasource.url instead of spring.datasource.url) before the application is started.

This build is a Stage 2 project skeleton per AGENTS.md: no inspection or analysis logic is implemented yet. Its only purpose is to prove the plugin loads cleanly in the IDE sandbox.
